people.name: Gideon
people.line: Judge of Israel; defeated Midianites; tested and reassured by God.

translations.web: Gideon said to them, “I will not rule over you, neither shall my son rule over you. Yahweh shall rule over you.”
translations.bsb: But Gideon replied, “I will not rule over you, nor will my son. The LORD shall rule over you.”
translations.kjv: And Gideon said unto them, I will not rule over you, neither shall my son rule over you: the LORD shall rule
translations.asv: And Gideon said unto them, I will not rule over you, neither shall my son rule over you: Jehovah shall rule over you.
